newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lankan blue chips slip on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lankan blue chips slip on profit-taking.

text.p: Prices of Sri Lankan blue chips fell on Monday morning due to profit-taking by retail investors, brokers said.

Richard Pieris & Co fell 11.19 percent or 16 rupees to 127, Lanka Orix Leasing 4.04 percent or 9.50 rupees to 225.50, Hayleys Ltd two percent or five rupees to 245, Lanka Ceramic Ltd 1.21 percent or 50 cents to 40.75.
"Small retail investors are taking profit among these blue chips, which rose sharply in the last 10 days," said a broker.
Prices of Colombo stocks rose sharply in June after analysts upgraded earnings forecasts for the market for 1997 and 1998, brokers said.
